title: Rhyme Three · Teams
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Rhyme Three · Teams with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Pick a common short word such as cat or boat. The lead says three different real words that rhyme with it. The other players agree all three rhyme. Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Rhyme Three, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The other players agree all three rhyme.
recall.why: The other players agree all three rhyme.
